# DynaSlots

DynaSlots: Slot-Centric 3D Dynamics Pretraining for Robot Manipulation

**2026-10-23 · Preprint · Beihang University**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32330)** · [Project](https://zhucezhanghao12345-source.github.io/DynaSlots-Anonymous/) · [Code](https://github.com/zhucezhanghao12345-source/DynaSlots-Anonymous)

Temporally propagated 3D object slots and latent dynamics provide geometry-aware context for a downstream diffusion policy.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/dynaslots-policy.webp" width="760" alt="Fig. 2: DynaSlots framework. (a) Three point-cloud frames are encoded by a shared Point Transformer and propagated by a temporal slot binder into K = 6 K{=}6 aligned soft slots. The IDM extracts per-slot latent actions from feature differences, and the cross-slot encoder conditions a diffusion FDM on current slot features, centroids, and actions. An EMA target branch supplies noised future slot features, while an auxiliary interaction head predicts pairwise proximity-and-motion relations. The di"/>

**Scope and qualifications**

- Slot consistency is local to the context window, not persistent identity tracking over an entire episode.
- Simulation baseline values are imported from AFRO rather than all re-run under identical source.
